title: Agentic Factory AIMS-oriented AI Transparency Register Schema
description: Schema for transparency-register.json emitted by Agentic Factory Audit Evidence Pack (AF-AUDIT-PACK-001). Rows are AIMS-oriented evidence pointers derived from factory artifacts (CQC/PAQ, MSA exhibit, gate receipts, ABOM, program id). This is not an ISO/IEC 42001 accreditation certificate and does not claim EU AI Act high-risk dossier completeness.

rows.description: Evidence-oriented transparency rows produced by build_transparency_register_rows().

row_id.description: Stable row identifier (e.g. AIM-CQC, AIM-MSA, AIM-REC-<receipt-stem>, AIM-ABOM, AIM-PROJECT).

topic.description: Human-readable topic for the evidence row.

evidence.description: Pointer to the evidence artifact (path, receipt name, or program id).

paq_enabled.description: Present on AIM-CQC rows when governance PAQ state is recorded.

note.description: Optional clarifying note (e.g. MSA exhibit residual).

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the referenced receipt or ABOM file.
